stem.text: A block is submerged vertically in a liquid. The four diagrams show, to scale, the forces exerted by the liquid on the block.
Which diagram correctly shows a possible situation as viewed from the side?

A.alt: Rectangle with arrows pointing towards it from all four sides.

B.alt: Rectangle with arrows pointing towards it from the top and bottom only.

C.alt: Rectangle with arrows pointing towards it from all four sides.

D.alt: Rectangle with arrows pointing towards it from all four sides.
